reason: The inspected revision treats reliability as interface design: it distinguishes saved answers from confirmed submission, submitted observations from valid independent evidence, and an uncertain close from a failed close. The first-encounter proposition states student leadership, no consulting fee and one academic semester before asking for an inquiry. The supplied mobile homepage has a coherent restrained hierarchy; the optional process bench lets the practical proposition and partnership context arrive early. Partnership copy correctly stops short of claiming approved engagement results. I traced the student preparation-to-application-recovery/submission/status journey through source and synthetic tests, rather than observing a real account complete it. The recovery capture makes changed answers, exact per-field choices, personal-data download limits and consequential whole-copy choices legible. Submission now validates its receipt or reconciles same-cycle stored status before deleting recovery, and the dashboard independently checks persisted submission. The earlier two focal objections are therefore addressed within this local scope. Close grading now bounds the complete request, preserves an unknown-outcome lock across same-tab reload, reads authoritative round status and prevents repeat confirmation after ambiguous writes. Its regression assertions explicitly cover dropped acknowledgements, unavailable/ACTIVE reads and subsequent verified closure. Release diagnostics share canonical database readiness counts and distinguish closed-round owner remediation from collecting genuine observations while open. The synthetic diagnostic capture communicates that readiness is not approval or release. These are substantial strengths, but broad world-class agreement and an operational release recommendation remain unproven: hosted identity, storage, RPC authorization and consequential recovery have not been exercised together. Approved work artifacts and current membership workload facts also remain absent. I found no new actionable source defect in the sampled paths; absence of a finding does not establish full acceptance.
notVerified: No hosted integrated authenticated application, evaluator or operator journey; actual Clerk expiry, Supabase RLS/RPC wiring, upload/storage and email behavior remain unverified.

No observed human task completion, screen-reader session, physical iPhone or macOS Safari acceptance; private visual review is limited to the supplied synthetic captures.

Client-approved engagement question, methods, deliverable and bounded outcome; Board-confirmed membership workload; Board policy decisions on identifying resumes, retention and closed-round remediation remain outstanding.
